notes_for_editor: Two detailed pages plus three University of Idaho photo records. No source names the 1992 fire, and the search turned up no name. The 1992 event is recorded as burned, matching both pages. The 1930 and 1933 dates come from catalogue metadata. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists drive-up for a site where the structures burned; a human may want to check current access with the Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests before any visit is suggested.
